import os
import requests
import stripe
stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_API_KEY']
STAFF_HOOK = os.environ['STAFF_CHAT_WEBHOOK']

def _post_staff_notice(reservation_id, amount, intent_id):
    text = f'No-show fee of ${amount / 100:.2f} charged for reservation {reservation_id} ({intent_id})'
    requests.post(STAFF_HOOK, json={'text': text}, timeout=10).raise_for_status()

def _restrict_guest_booking(customer_id, reservation_id):
    # Downgrade the guest's booking role so future reservations require a prepaid deposit
    stripe.Customer.modify(customer_id, metadata={'booking_role': 'deposit_required', 'role_reason_reservation': reservation_id})

def charge_no_show_fee(customer_id: str, payment_method_id: str, reservation_id: str, fee_cents: int) -> dict:
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=fee_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, payment_method=payment_method_id, off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'No-show fee for reservation {reservation_id}', metadata={'reservation_id': reservation_id})
    _restrict_guest_booking(customer_id, reservation_id)
    _post_staff_notice(reservation_id, fee_cents, pi.id)
    return {'payment_intent': pi.id, 'status': pi.status}
